output.brief: The fall in incidents is not real. Confirmed cases reaching Incident–Confirmed were 37 in September and 36 in October, in line with the roughly 38 a month before the migration. In those two months, 47 confirmed cases were moved to "Suspicious Activity–Monitoring" about 3h31m–3h42m after opening. That is just after the 3h30m SLA warning. The moves came from a script on a Brackwater analyst jump host, using the integration account. The connector itself wrote no category changes, so this is not a platform fault. Once moved, cases drop out of the containment and SLA figures. That is why containment looks perfect and the 60k bonus looks earned. Only 11 of the 47 have notes describing containment steps, and none has a containment timestamp. Do not cut the IR retainer and do not pay the bonus. Reinstate the 47 cases and have the in-house team and Halvard verify containment on each. Remove category-write rights from the integration role. Ask Brackwater in writing who built the script and why, and hold off on the renewal and any service-credit claims until that is answered. I am confident in this. Still unknown: whether the 28 dropped rules left detection gaps, and who at Brackwater authorised the script.
